topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 53 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens, 8 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable, erc1155holder). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
